links.outcome: Accuracy and F1 for AO/OTA 31A vs 31B classification on a balanced test set of 70 cases
links.effect: Few-shot (5 examples per class) accuracy 88.57% (F1 = 88.53%) vs zero-shot accuracy 94.29% (F1 = 94.28%)
links.tradeoff: Few-shot performance dropped unexpectedly relative to zero-shot
links.quote: Zero‑shot prompting attained the same accuracy (94.29%, F1 = 94.28%), while few‑shot learning unexpectedly dropped to 88.57% (F1 = 88.53%).
